narrative.overview:
The day's orders run like a timetable; stock reads like a passbook. Today opens on a departure board: the clock and what waits, each waiting figure marked by a yellow bar. Below it the working surface is white paper ruled into columns: a 2px ink rule under each sheet's head, 1px hairlines between rows, every running figure flush right. Each order is a departure with its time, its channel line and how long it has waited; a late one prints ล่าช้า in red like a delay notice. Stock history prints as passbook rows that end in today's balance, so any number can be explained by reading down.

One text size (14px) does most of the work. Rank comes from column, weight and ink, not from bigger type or colour fills. Lists are ranked by meaning: the queue by how long an order has waited, stock by how soon it runs out.

History: Platform Board replaced "Stockroom" on 2026-10-21. The owner found Stockroom's thick navy page band, pill buttons, highlighter-underlined condensed counts and equal white cards read as AI-generated.

Pinned by the user, keep these in any future change: the palette (navy, marker yellow, cool canvas) and the minimal white sidebar with small icons, group headings and the yellow current bar.
keyCharacteristics: One navy board per screen at most (Today); every other page title sits on the canvas over a 2px ink rule.
White sheets ruled like a timetable: 2px ink rule under the head, 1px hairlines between rows.
Square 3px buttons; 4px sheets and chips; 6px dialogs and inputs.
Bai Jamjuree everywhere, tabular figures everywhere, counts in the `figure` weight.
Channels as 4px coloured line bars, status as weighted text, chips only for exceptions.
Passbook rows for stock history: วันที่ / รายการ / เข้า / ออก / คงเหลือ.

rules.name: The Numbers In Ink Rule
rules.body: Counts, money and balances are full ink. A figure only changes colour for a reason: navy with a yellow bar on the board when work waits, Ink 3 when it is zero, red when it is late or sold out.

rules.name: The Yellow Waits Rule
rules.body: Yellow means "waiting for you" or "you are here". It never carries body text on white and never marks an ordinary action; its only button is ขายหน้าร้าน on the navy board.

rules.name: The On-Brand Remap Rule
rules.body: Inside navy (the top bar) the `on-brand` utility turns ink white and ink 2/3 pale and makes outline buttons translucent. Components placed on navy need no navy-specific classes.

rules.name: The One Size Does The Work Rule
rules.body: 14px carries most text. Rank a row's facts by column, weight (400 / 500 / 600 / 700) and ink (ink / ink 2 / ink 3), not by new sizes. The steps above are the whole scale.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Counts use Bai Jamjuree with the `figure` utility (600, line 1). No condensed, stencil or display face for numbers.

rules.name: The Rules Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 2px ink rule, a 1px hairline or space. A shadow under a sheet on the page is wrong.

dos: Do put a 2px ink rule (`sheet-head`) under each sheet's head or column labels, and 1px hairlines between rows.
Do set every count in Bai Jamjuree with `figure`, flush right in its column, in full ink unless it is waiting (yellow on navy), zero (Ink 3) or late or sold out (red).
Do rank lists by meaning: the queue by wait, stock by how soon it runs out.
Do print stock history as passbook rows with blank cells where nothing moved, an opening ยอดยกมา and a ruled คงเหลือวันนี้.
Do keep destructive actions away from the primary, behind space and a rule, and confirm them in a dialog.
Do keep the pinned palette and the pinned sidebar.
donts: Don't put a navy band behind a page title. Navy is the top bar and the Today board only.
Don't use pill buttons; buttons are 3px.
Don't put a highlighter stroke under a number.
Don't box figures into equal stat cards; they sit on the board behind their bars, or in their column.
Don't put a coloured stripe on the leading edge of a row; a selected row is a fill and a bold name.
Don't colour-code types with a rainbow of chips; status is weighted text, a chip marks an exception.
Don't use segmented pills for filters; filters are underline tabs.
Don't set a count in any face or weight but Bai Jamjuree `figure`.
Don't print holds as figures in a passbook; holds live in จองไว้ and in the holds list.
Don't add shadows to sheets on the page, or new font sizes outside the hierarchy.
